approvers: Developer or main contractor who sets the subcontract package
reason: We spend about 1,500 a year on protection and rely on the factory film. At 19 euro per m2 this is far more than we pay today, and nobody in the subcontract package is asking me to cover glass. A 50% deposit does not fit how we buy either.
objection: 19 euro per m2 plus a 50% deposit and a 150 m2 minimum, when I pay suppliers at 60 to 90 days and the developer decides who pays for protection.
instead: Keep the factory film on the aluminium profiles, with cheap tape or film where a job needs it.
would_change_my_mind: The developer or main contractor writing glass protection into the package and paying for it, at a price near 3 to 4 euro per m2 with 60 day terms.
